test: ROS-controlled physical LED on Raspberry Pi 5

procedure.control: ROS Noetic /lamp/set service via native gpiozero/lgpio agent
procedure.on_command: docker exec course204-lamp /course-entrypoint.sh rosservice call /lamp/set true
procedure.off_command: docker exec course204-lamp /course-entrypoint.sh rosservice call /lamp/set false

physical_observation.evidence: User confirmed seeing the LED work after being asked whether it illuminated and extinguished during the three-cycle test.
physical_observation.limitations: User observation only; no captured video or independently inspected wiring. The instructed circuit uses a series 330-ohm resistor, but its installed value was not measured.

privacy: No credentials, network addresses or private device identifiers included
